judgment: People together in the open country:
It is good to ford the great river.
It is good for the noble one to hold firm.
image: So the noble one sorts the clans
lines: People together at the clan shrine.
Soldiers lie hidden in the thicket,
three years, and they do not rise.
first they wail, then they laugh.
A great host manages to meet.
People together at the edge of town.

notes.name_en: 同人 people together (in the wilds, at the gate); not Wilhelm's 'Fellowship with Men'.
notes.L5: 大師克相遇: the great host manages to meet — 克 as managing/can (no 'at last').
